exec /bin/sh -c 's=${SHELL:-/bin/sh}; case "$s" in *zsh) m=z ;; *bash) m=b ;; *) m=n ;; esac; n=etty-4f2a9c1b; c=$HOME/.cache/etty; t=$(command -v tmux 2>/dev/null); mkdir -p "$c" 2>/dev/null || exec "$s" -l; chmod 700 "$c" 2>/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "exec \"\${SHELL:-/bin/sh}\" -l" > "$c/init.$$" && mv -f "$c/init.$$" "$c/init"; chmod 700 "$c/init" 2>/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "set -g allow-passthrough on" "set -g status off" "set -g mouse off" "set -s set-clipboard on" "set -as terminal-features \",*:clipboard\"" "bind-key -T copy-mode Enter send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "bind-key -T copy-mode-vi Enter send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "bind-key -T copy-mode-vi y send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "set -s extended-keys on" "set -as terminal-features \",*:extkeys\"" "bind-key -n S-Enter send-keys Escape \"[13;2u\"" "bind-key -n C-M-S-Up if -F \"#{alternate_on}\" \"send-keys PPage\" \"copy-mode -e ; send-keys -X -N 3 scroll-up\"" "bind-key -n C-M-S-Down if -F \"#{alternate_on}\" \"send-keys NPage\" \"send-keys -X -N 3 scroll-down\"" "set -g history-limit 10000" "set -g escape-time 10" "set -g focus-events on" "set -g window-size latest" "set -g default-terminal screen-256color" "set -as terminal-features \",*:RGB\"" "set -g prefix None" > "$c/tmux.conf.$$"; printf "set -g default-command \"/bin/sh %s/init\"\n" "$c" >> "$c/tmux.conf.$$"; mv -f "$c/tmux.conf.$$" "$c/tmux.conf"; [ -n "$t" ] && "$t" -u -L etty list-sessions >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$t" -u -L etty source-file "$c/tmux.conf" >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ -z "$t" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$c/init"; fi; exec "$t" -u -L etty -f "$c/tmux.conf" new-session -A -D -s "$n" "/bin/sh $c/init"'
